name: transition-iris-open
title: Iris
description: Một vòng tròn từ giữa khung mở rộng tới góc xa nhất, lộ cảnh mới.

moworks.author: takayu

options.duration: s (0.6; a 2-4 frame iris also works)
options.ease: power2.in (cubic); the site's demo eases in-out

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-iris, written here): Incoming scene inside a circle centred on the frame, radius 0 -> the centre-to-corner distance (hypot(W, H) / 2; the recipe writes hypot(W, H)), 600 ms easeInCubic (the demo eases in-out); outgoing scene still; no rim, no dimming. A fast 2-4 frame iris also works. Params: duration (0.6 s) · x, y: tâm (giữa khung) · ease (power2.in).
